create_Qwen2ForSequenceClassification: create a Qwen2ForSequenceClassification model with a Qwen2Config and optional quantization config
run_Qwen2ForSequenceClassification_forwa: run the forward pass of Qwen2ForSequenceClassification on input_ids and positions to produce embedding pooler output
load_Qwen2ForSequenceClassification_weig: load pretrained weights into Qwen2ForSequenceClassification filtering out lm_head weights from Qwen2ForCausalLM checkpoint
build_Qwen2_sequence_classifier: build a Qwen2-based sequence classification model that scores hidden states and pools with last-token strategy
test_Qwen2ForSequenceClassification: test Qwen2ForSequenceClassification as an embedding-only model entry point in the sglang srt models module
